hook: Two hikers. One dog. One helicopter ride out.
narration: These two hikers and their dog got a helicopter ride off an Arizona mountain.
Air and Marine agents set the helicopter down on the hillside near Willcox.
An agent pushed through the brush on foot to reach them.
Agents always bring people in from the front, in the pilots' view, away from the tail rotor.
Their dog rode out in one hiker's arms.
outcome: The crew flew both hikers and their dog off the mountain to safety.
title: Hikers and dog airlifted off a mountain
description:
U.S. Customs and Border Protection Office of Air and Marine agents flew two hikers and their dog off a mountainside near Willcox, Arizona, on Aug. 16, 2014.

Footage: U.S. Customs and Border Protection video by Daniel Barrios, Office of Air and Marine, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/356087/cbp-oam-agents-rescue-hikers-and-dog
